title: Disney drops GitHub Copilot, adds OpenAI's Codex in AI tool shake-up
excerpt: Disney is shaking up its AI tools by moving on from Microsoft's GitHub Copilot. It's also planning to add OpenAI's Codex alongside Claude and Cursor.
content_html:
Disney has decided it no longer needs a Copilot on its AI coding journey.

The Mouse House is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and several other AI coding tools in August in the US, tech leaders told select staffers on Tuesday afternoon, according to a screenshot of an internal message viewed by Business Insider. These changes don't apply internationally, a Disney tech leader told employees.

A breakup with Disney is the latest headache for Microsoft's Copilot, which "lags behind" rivals like ChatGPT and Claude in adoption, as Business Insider's Ashley Stewart has reported. GitHub Copilot is the coding assistant in Microsoft's AI product suite.

Microsoft's loss is Sam Altman's win. Disney is preparing to adopt OpenAI's Codex coding tool, according to the screenshot. The message didn't give a timeline for the tool's introduction.

Disney will also keep staffers' access to Anthropic's Claude Enterprise and Cursor, while dropping two AI tools from Amazon: the agentic code editor Kiro and the AI assistant Q. (Claude will also no longer be accessible through the Amazon Web Services Bedrock platform.)

Copilot's challenges

Eight Disney tech employees told Business Insider that they rarely or never used GitHub Copilot.

One product manager said GitHub Copilot produced code that was "needlessly complex" and required clean-up.

A longtime software engineer said their access to GitHub Copilot had "lapsed for lack of use."

"Once I got Cursor and Kiro, there was no need to use it," this staffer said.

Copilot frustrated some users last month by updating its pricing to charge customers based on their AI token usage, which is industry-standard. The company said GitHub Copilot's request-based model was "no longer sustainable" as it unveiled the shift.

However, a Microsoft executive said in June that this move helped fuel the "best month ever" for the GitHub developer platform, Business Insider previously reported.

Microsoft has set out to revamp GitHub while shaking up its Copilot teams to help its many Copilot tools compete with rivals from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Disney staffers are enchanted by Claude and Cursor

Claude and Cursor have become fan favorites among Disney tech employees, as some superusers use agents to invoke those AI tools tens of thousands of times per day, Business Insider previously reported.

One high-level software engineer said their AI tool usage was "probably around 80% Claude at the terminal when coding."

Disney's streaming leaders created an AI adoption dashboard to track usage and have encouraged tech employees to use it to work faster, Business Insider previously reported.

"The No. 1 thing is to increase velocity," or the speed of output, a high-level AI staffer said.

content_html_zh:
迪士尼决定在其人工智能编码之旅中不再需要副驾驶。

根据《商业内幕》(Business Insider) 看到的内部消息截图，科技领导人周二下午告诉部分员工，Mouse House 将于 8 月份在美国放弃微软的 GitHub Copilot 和其他几种人工智能编码工具。 迪士尼的一位技术负责人告诉员工，这些变化并不适用于国际。

与迪士尼的分手是微软 Copilot 最新的头疼问题，据《商业内幕》的阿什利·斯图尔特 (Ashley Stewart) 报道，该公司在采用方面“落后于”ChatGPT 和 Claude 等竞争对手。 GitHub Copilot 是微软 AI 产品套件中的编码助手。

微软的失败是萨姆·奥尔特曼的胜利。 根据截图，迪士尼正准备采用 OpenAI 的 Codex 编码工具。 该消息没有给出该工具推出的时间表。

迪士尼还将保留员工对 Anthropic 的 Claude Enterprise 和 Cursor 的访问权限，同时放弃亚马逊的两款人工智能工具：代理代码编辑器 Kiro 和人工智能助手 Q。 （也将无法再通过 Amazon Web Services Bedrock 平台访问 Claude。）

副驾驶面临的挑战

八名迪士尼技术员工告诉 Business Insider，他们很少或从未使用过 GitHub Copilot。

一位产品经理表示，GitHub Copilot 生成的代码“过于复杂”，需要清理。

一位资深软件工程师表示，他们对 GitHub Copilot 的访问“因缺乏使用而失效”。

“一旦我得到了 Cursor 和 Kiro，就没有必要使用它了，”这位工作人员说。

Copilot 上个月更新了定价，根据客户的 AI 代币使用情况（这是行业标准）向他们收费，这让一些用户感到沮丧。 该公司表示，在宣布这一转变时，GitHub Copilot 基于请求的模式“不再可持续”。

然而，据 Business Insider 此前报道，微软高管在 6 月份表示，此举有助于推动 GitHub 开发者平台实现“有史以来最好的一个月”。

微软已着手改造 GitHub，同时重组其 Copilot 团队，以帮助其众多 Copilot 工具与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的竞争对手竞争。

迪士尼员工对克劳德和光标着迷

据 Business Insider 此前报道，Claude 和 Cursor 已成为迪士尼技术员工的最爱，因为一些超级用户每天使用代理调用这些人工智能工具数万次。

一位高级软件工程师表示，他们的人工智能工具使用率“大概有 80% 左右是 Claude 在终端编码时”。

据《商业内幕》此前报道，迪士尼的流媒体领导者创建了一个人工智能采用仪表板来跟踪使用情况，并鼓励技术员工使用它来加快工作速度。

一位高级人工智能工作人员表示，“首要任务是提高速度”，即输出速度。
